body.value: ○田原本藩
○田原本藩（たわらもとはん）

Domain marker: Tawaramoto Domain. The circle-plus-name device opens the domain's entry; everything printed to the LEFT of this marker, down to the next marker, is Tawaramoto's. Tawaramoto was a 10,000-koku domain in Yamato province held by the Hirano house (present-day Tawaramoto, Nara prefecture).
○田原本藩
權大參事　齋藤房帆
権大参事　斎藤房帆（さいとう ふさほ）

Acting senior councillor (gon-daisanji): Saitō Fusaho. The office title is set in the upper register and the name in the lower register of the same column. This is the domain's own roster; a second, variant list from another source follows further left.
田原本藩權大參事齋藤房帆
少參事　西谷善述
少参事　西谷善述（にしたに ぜんじゅつ）
Junior councillor (shōsanji): Nishitani Zenjutsu. The final glyph is 述 (辶 over 朮), not the similar 逑. This entry is printed on the page but is MISSING from the project's MASTER extraction.
田原本藩少參事西谷善述
小川正彬
（少参事）　小川正彬（おがわ まさあきら）

Ogawa Masaakira, a second junior councillor (shōsanji). The column carries a name only, with no office title above it, and sits in the same lower name register immediately left of Nishitani Zenjutsu - on HI officials pages an untitled name column continues the office of the column to its right. Also MISSING from the project's MASTER extraction.
田原本藩少參事小川正彬
兵隊　一小隊　此人員七十人
兵隊　一小隊、此の人員七十人

Troops: one platoon; the personnel thereof, seventy men. This is Tawaramoto's entire recorded military establishment. In fascicle 8 the military entry prints after the officials, which is why it stands between the domain's own roster and the variant roster taken from the caretaker official's register.
田原本藩兵隊一小隊
（一ニ）
（一に）

Editorial variant marker in vertical parentheses: 「（一ニ）」, 'one [version] has —'. It introduces an alternative list of Tawaramoto's officials drawn from a different source, which is named at the end of the group as the caretaker official's register （留守官留書）. It does NOT read '(2)' and does not number a section.
田原本藩第二名簿標記
大參事　姫島嘉津尾
大参事　姫島嘉津尾（ひめじま かづお）
Senior councillor (daisanji): Himeshima Kazuo - first entry of the variant roster introduced by 「（一ニ）」 and sourced to the caretaker official's register.
田原本藩第二名簿大參事姫島嘉津尾
權大參事　齋藤俊郎
権大参事　斎藤俊郎（さいとう としろう）
Acting senior councillor (gon-daisanji): Saitō Toshirō, in the variant roster from the caretaker official's register.
田原本藩第二名簿權大參事齋藤俊郎
少參事　下間喜藤太
少参事　下間喜藤太（しもつま きとうた）
Junior councillor (shōsanji): Shimotsuma Kitōta, in the variant roster from the caretaker official's register.
田原本藩第二名簿少參事下間喜藤太
權少參事　西谷直圓
権少参事　西谷直円（にしたに なおまる）

Acting junior councillor (gon-shōsanji): Nishitani Naomaru, last entry of the variant roster from the caretaker official's register. The Nishitani surname recurs from the domain's own roster on the right of the leaf.
田原本藩第二名簿權少參事西谷直圓
（留守官留書）
（留守官留書）

Editorial source note in vertical parentheses: 'from the register kept by the caretaker official (rusukan)'. It names the source of the variant Tawaramoto roster introduced above by 「（一ニ）」. Although it prints close to the Tateyama columns, it lies to the RIGHT of the ○館山藩 marker and so belongs to the previous domain, Tawaramoto.
田原本藩留守官留書出典註
○館山藩
○館山藩（たてやまはん）

Domain marker: Tateyama Domain. Everything to the left of this marker on the leaf is Tateyama's. Tateyama was a 10,000-koku domain in Awa province held by the Inaba house (present-day Tateyama, Chiba prefecture).
○館山藩
佐々木　大參事　義耶
大参事　佐々木義耶（ささき よしや）

Senior councillor (daisanji): Sasaki Yoshiya. The Tateyama columns use a different setting from the Tawaramoto ones - surname, then office title, then the given name in smaller type, all in one continuous run (the 姓＋官名＋諱 order).
館山藩大參事佐々木義耶
島村　權大參事　偉藏
権大参事　島村偉蔵（しまむら いぞう）

Acting senior councillor (gon-daisanji): Shimamura Izō. The two small given-name glyphs are heavily over-inked in this impression; the reading follows the project's existing extraction and is consistent with the surviving stroke mass (亻+韋 for 偉; grass radical over 臣+戈 for 藏).
館山藩權大參事島村偉藏
松下　權大參事　直衞　公議人
権大参事　松下直衛（まつした なおえ）／公議人

Acting senior councillor (gon-daisanji): Matsushita Naoe, who additionally served as the domain's kōgisho representative (公議人). Below the office title the setting splits into two small side-by-side runs: the right-hand run (read first) is the given name 直衞, set with its two characters spread to the top and bottom of the run; the left-hand run is the additional post 公議人.
館山藩權大參事松下直衞
藩制一覧表第八（田原本、館山）
藩制一覧表第八（田原本、館山）

Running header: Hansei ichiran (Survey of Domain Institutions), Table Eight, covering Tawaramoto and Tateyama. Fascicle 8 is the officials-and-military fascicle. The header names both domains printed on the leaf, so it agrees with the data rather than pointing elsewhere.
